tasks.description: Public SWE-bench Lite representative task for the SQLFluff L060 IFNULL/NVL diagnostic wording.

agent.instructions: Fix SQLFluff issue sqlfluff__sqlfluff-2419. Rule L060 must emit exactly "Use 'COALESCE' instead of 'IFNULL'." for IFNULL and exactly "Use 'COALESCE' instead of 'NVL'." for NVL. Apply the smallest focused change to src/sqlfluff/rules/L060.py, then run a relevant verification command through the command tool and report the result.

public_test_patch.content:
diff --git a/test/rules/std_L060_test.py b/test/rules/std_L060_test.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/rules/std_L060_test.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Tests the python routines within L060."""
+import sqlfluff
+
+
+def test__rules__std_L060_raised() -> None:
+    """L060 is raised for use of ``IFNULL`` or ``NVL``."""
+    sql = "SELECT\n\tIFNULL(NULL, 100),\n\tNVL(NULL,100);"
+    result = sqlfluff.lint(sql, rules=["L060"])
+
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert result[0]["description"] == "Use 'COALESCE' instead of 'IFNULL'."
+    assert result[1]["description"] == "Use 'COALESCE' instead of 'NVL'."

+"""Independent hidden checks for L060 diagnostics."""
+import pytest
+import sqlfluff
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("function_name", "description"),
+    [("IFNULL", "Use 'COALESCE' instead of 'IFNULL'."),
+     ("NVL", "Use 'COALESCE' instead of 'NVL'.")],
+)
+def test__rules__std_L060_individual_diagnostics(function_name, description) -> None:
+    result = sqlfluff.lint(f"SELECT {function_name}(1, 2)", rules=["L060"])
+    assert len(result) == 1
+    assert result[0]["description"] == description

tasks.description: Local Python repository-context task for signed billing reports with service fees.

agent.instructions: Fix the seeded billing report behavior in src/billing/ledger.py and src/billing/report.py. First use list, grep, and read to inspect the multi-directory repository and trace the billing rules; only modify those two source files, do not modify smoke_test.py or add dependencies. Run a relevant verification command through the command tool after your focused edits and report the result.

public_test_patch.content:
diff --git a/tests/test_public_billing.py b/tests/test_public_billing.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_public_billing.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import unittest
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from src.billing.ledger import net_amount
+from src.billing.report import build_report
+
+
+class PublicBillingTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_sales_and_refunds_are_aggregated_before_fee(self):
+        entries = [
+            {"reference": "sale-100", "amount": "125.50"},
+            {"reference": "refund-20", "amount": "-20.00"},
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(net_amount(entries), Decimal("105.50"))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            build_report(entries, "0.05"),
+            {
+                "net": Decimal("105.50"),
+                "service_fee": Decimal("5.28"),
+                "grand_total": Decimal("110.78"),
+            },
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
